def sig(rpr):
    # compact formatting signature
    parts=[]
    for c in rpr:
        tag=c.tag.replace(W,'')
        attrs=tuple(sorted((k.replace(W,''),v) for k,v in c.attrib.items()))
        parts.append(tag+str(attrs))

The samples of older people who responded directly (altogether 933 older
people, aged 60 and over), were summarised descriptively. The overall
prevalence of suspected cognitive impairment was evaluated for the whole
